what: `Phoenix.VerifiedRoutes`' `~p` sigil URL-encodes an interpolated query slot itself: `~p"/path?#{URI.encode_query(map)}"` double-encodes the query into `x%3D2.0%26frame%3D0`, while `~p"/path?#{map}"` encodes the map exactly once (via Plug.Conn.Query.encode). Pass the query as a map (e.g. `Param.encode/2` plus a frame key), not a pre-encoded string.
why: Hit while wiring the workbench LiveView URL state in Plan 2; the failure is silent (the URL is valid but the params never decode).
